import sys

def power_mod(b, e, m):
    return pow(b, e, m)

def process():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    mod = 998244353
    inv2 = power_mod(2, mod - 2, mod)
    diff = R - L + 1
    p1 = diff // 2
    p2 = diff - p1
    nm = n * m

    if (nm & 1) == 1:
        ans = power_mod(diff, nm, mod)
    else:
        pp1 = diff
        pp2 = abs(p1 - p2)
        opt1 = power_mod(pp1, nm, mod)
        opt2 = power_mod(pp2, nm, mod)
        opt = (opt1 + opt2) % mod
        opt = (opt * inv2) % mod
        ans = opt

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    process()
